title: Liouville theorems and symmetry of positive solutions for partially confined nonlinear Schrödinger equations
summary: We study positive solutions of the partially confined stationary nonlinear Schrödinger equation $$-Δu+|y|^2u+λu=g(u),\quad (y,z)\in\mathbb{R}^d\times\mathbb{R}^{m},\quad 1\leq d -d$, we establish the existence of positive solutions under some standard assumptions. Furthermore, every positive solution decaying at infinity is radially symmetric and strictly decreasing in the confined variables and, up to one common translation, radially symmetric and strictly decreasing in the free variables. \vskip 0.2in Dedicated to our supervisor Prof. Wenming Zou on the occasion of his 60th birthday.
